description: Research r23 (dev only, step-capped, B200 workers): r22 mal0_st500_ent01_t10_lr2e-6 (r16 + entropy bonus 0.01 on steps after one whose logged entropy was below 0.1, lr 2e-6) with grad_clip 0.15 instead of 1.0. The first logged grad norms (r22 ent01 seed 4, gc03 seed 0, steps 1-175) have median 0.17 and max 0.34, so clip 1.0 never binds and 0.3 almost never; 0.15 binds on about two thirds of the steps (122 of gc03 seed 0's first 176) and caps any spike at about the typical size. Tests whether that stops the truncation-led collapse of r22 ent01 seed 1 (step 350).
